note: Goal-v2 agentic eval. Each meeting is a COMPLETE speaker transcript authored/collected in advance; its questions and expected answers are extracted from that transcript BEFORE the run. The transcript is synthesized turn-by-turn through the live chatterbox -> PipeWire -> Docker STT -> resolver -> retrieval path in real time, and each produced card is judged for SEMANTIC SIMILARITY to the expected answer by an agentic judge (SciLLM), not token overlap. A card that is technically on-topic but does not convey the expected answer fails.
